title: Ferroptosis in endodontic pathobiology: Emerging evidence, mechanistic rationale, and translational uncertainties
html: Ferroptosis is an iron-dependent form of regulated cell death characterized by lipid peroxidation and impaired antioxidant defense. Its defining biochemical features, including iron-redox imbalance and lipid peroxide accumulation, overlap with biological conditions present in infected, hypoxic, and cytokine-rich endodontic tissues. This narrative review examined the potential role of ferroptosis in endodontic pathobiology, with emphasis on separating direct endodontic evidence from indirect or extrapolated oral evidence.
